reviews.title: Changing terms after purchase
reviews.text: Bought this thing. Installed the app. It was working pretty well with a few bugs from time to time. Then I updated my phone and the app and now it’s asking me to create an account. Why do I need an account? I have the device, I have the app. I didn’t need an account before. Now, after I’ve purchased the product, I can’t use it unless I create an account. Not cool.

reviews.title: It’s a scam
reviews.text: The app does not work. When it enters NFC to cancel the alarm, more than half the time it cannot sense the block, and you end up rubbing it against your phone for 5 minutes before you finally waste an emergency-off. Lately the app won’t even enter NFC mode to scan the block in the first place. The app suddenly demanded I make an account and give it demographic information (for an alarm???) months after install. So yeah, it’s some kind of data harvesting scam, and the alarm doesn’t even work. Stay far away. Consider any alternative. Lasso, Unpluq, or Alarmy.

reviews.title: Saved My Job
reviews.text:
Unbed has been a game changer. I have had problems with oversleeping for so long. I got fired from a job for missing opening shifts. I was put on a performance improvement plan with my current job. I’ve missed doctor’s appointments, family commitments, etc. because of oversleeping. I tried bed shakers, the ShockClock, various alarms that promised to get me out of bed. UnBed has been the first thing to work. All the others I found ways to shut off or work around, or I’d simply fall back asleep in my morning zombie state. Unbed doesn’t play. I bought it back in January when the app was still fairly simple and I did have some trouble at that point with being able to work around loose protections. Yall, this is a small company. It takes time to grow and learn and work out the bugs. As they’ve added to the app it’s pretty watertight. It’s integrated into screen time so you can’t delete it, there are settings that stop you from changing the alarm after bedtime, you can block apps, plus a million other awesome features. I set it to where I have to take a picture of the sky to shut the alarm off so I have to physically walk outside or at least open a window. And there’s plenty of other challenges. Overall just an incredible app. I get out of bed on time. I’m off my improvement plan at work. I don’t doom scroll until 2am. It’s been awesome. 

Thanks for saving my job y’all!

reviews.title: It works
reviews.text: I had a problem on scrolling on my phone after I turn off the alarm. With unbed to actually get up to turn it off it been working to help me start the day

reviews.title: Really good app!! But…
reviews.text: I have had a hard time getting out of bed my entire life, and I’ve tried all sorts of things to try and make myself get up, with nothing lasting very long. Unbed is the first time I’ve had such success, because it’s really nonnegotiable. If you walk back to your room and lay back in bed after the unbed alarm, well— nothing is gonna work for you LOL. It makes you get up, and it won’t let your evil, sleepy self escape from the morning! Now I got this just a few weeks before the subscription and account aspects showed up, so I had a small amount of time to get used to the base app, and I will say that I think there are a few things that need tuning after that update. Is Morning Peace now locked behind a subscription to set it to an alarm? Because it doesn’t work anymore for me. I have to go and find it and activate it, which kind of defeats the purpose of blocking them right after waking up because I can allow myself to be tempted to just not turn it on. I’m glad none of the base features have been put behind a subscription, but it feels a bit like the base app needs a bit of tuning so that people who can’t afford a subscription are getting the exact same experience that people were before the subscription update. Also, I am a bit disturbed by one of the features in unbed plus— that it LISTENS IN without any extra device, listening to you sleep to somehow detect the best time to wake you up…? That feels wrong. How can we know the app doesn’t just have the capability to listen in whenever? How on earth can it detect the sleep cycle from the sound of the room it’s in without any extra devices? It’s just rather disturbing to me. This is such a helpful app and tool, I really hope it isn’t violating people’s privacy like that.

reviews.title: LIFE CHANGING!
reviews.text:
I’ve always been a professional snoozer… until Unbed. 😂

I’ve tried everything, and this is the first alarm that’s actually worked for me. I love that it’s simple—no math problems or complicated puzzles when you’re half asleep (because who has the brainpower for that first thing in the morning?).

We keep our Unbed tag by the coffee maker, which is set to auto-brew every morning. So when my alarm goes off, I have to get up, walk to the coffee, and scan it. By then, I’m already up and ready to start my day.

The temporary silence feature is also brilliant. I can mute it just long enough to quietly leave my daughter’s room without waking her, but there’s no snooze button to tempt me back into bed.

If you’re a chronic snoozer like I was, this app is absolutely worth trying. It’s completely changed my mornings.

reviews.title: No More Battery Issues!
reviews.text: The developers sorted out the battery issues since my last review - 10/10 would recommend

reviews.title: The longer I have used Unbed, the more frustrating it has become
reviews.text: I regret spending $40 on the Unbed block. The app is almost completely unusable and very frustrating to navigate. I wish this “just worked”. App refuses to open on the first try almost every time. Alarms don’t always ring. No screen comes up when the alarm does ring, so you have to manually open the app to scan the block and shut it off. Trouble saving and setting alarms reliably - the save button just does not work at all most of the time, and I have to close and reopen the app several times, every time. There is some “software gore” going on and pressing a button sometimes presses other buttons. When it works, it works, except for when I go straight back to bed. Or lay on my phone to dampen the sound. Lol. Set backup alarms. Or better yet, find a solution that is not this disappointing app. I am curious about “Lasso alarm”.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text: I have had a sleep disorder for about 10 years now where I have trouble waking up. I have tried SO many alarms and I think this is a winner. The only downside is there are a couple of workarounds. For one, you can just shut down the phone. I wish there was a way to enable a password or something to stop a hard shut off, but Apple does not have that anymore. The second is uninstalling the app. Now I have found a way around this. My lovely sister set a screen time password that doesn’t let me uninstall the app; however, I can’t uninstall any apps now, but that is a minor issue. Overall, I love it. I rave about it and I have been able to get up and do a 2-3 mile walk on most days, but on the hard days, I simply just shut down my phone. On a second note. I would love the ability to customize more. Change colors. More sounds. The ability to play sleep sounds on a timer. Minor things but I still like this app!

The developers are absolutely doing amazing work at keeping a neat, clean, functional and bug-less experience. I trust it to be set when I set it and go off when I need it. I’m at work on time every day without fail and might even wake up earlier to get more out of my day.

reviews.title: UNBED CHANGED THE GAME FOR ME

reviews.title: A simple but life-changing tool
reviews.text:
I host the morning show for a local NPR station — that means I get up at 2:35 a.m. every day!

With that schedule, Unbed has been absolutely life-changing for me. Yes, my body does react like a fire alarm went off off every morning. But I have not overslept once since I started using the Unbed last summer.

As a person with anxiety, it’s such a comfort to know that — without a doubt — the alarm will go off and immediately get me up and out of bed. I know I will not oversleep and will instead be at work and ready to go on the air on time. It’s a peace of mind that’s pretty much priceless.

Thanks to the Unbed team for this simple but effective concept that makes such a difference in my day.
